subsystems.title: Delphi RTL and VCL
subsystems.notes: System, SysUtils, Classes, Graphics, Controls, Forms, StdCtrls, ComCtrls, Grids, OLE and TWebBrowser. Only behaviour the game relies on is reproduced (string handling, Delphi date doubles, VCL click order).

subsystems.title: Graphics backend (DelphiX, DirectDraw, JPEG, rodraw2)
subsystems.notes: TDXDraw and DirectDraw surfaces become surface.Surface (RGB565) presented by Ebitengine. rodraw2.dll blits are ported one by one as they are met: colour key, light alpha, alpha fill.

subsystems.title: Audio backend (DirectSound, Ogg, MCI)
subsystems.notes: TDXSound buffers, Ogg streams and TMediaPlayer become Ebitengine audio players over the exported PCM WAV files.

subsystems.title: Input backend (DXInput)
subsystems.notes: Keyboard, mouse and joystick devices.

subsystems.title: Network transport (sockets, HTTP)
subsystems.notes: TClientSocket and the NetMasters HTTP components. The packet framing and XOR are ported in login.

subsystems.title: Asset decryption and data files
subsystems.notes: JMA/JXAN decryption, .wmg data; the exports under data/ replace runtime decoding.

subsystems.title: Main form and frame loop (TForm4)
subsystems.notes: FormCreate, the 30 ms frame timer (timeSetEvent → message 0x8002 → FUN_004a1d60), the sound table, music start. Ported: the frame order for login and world, map music, ambience. Not yet: the remaining FormCreate steps, window modes, most per-frame managers.

subsystems.title: Packet dispatch (send and receive)
subsystems.notes: FUN_002c2394 sends, FUN_002dde1c receives. See the command coverage table.

subsystems.title: UI framework (se_UI, picture database)
subsystems.notes: TSe_UIHandler, TSe_GrBasic and the components, buttons, editors, lists, scroll bars, forms; TSe_CachePicDB. Components still unported are noted where met (chat log hit test, item grids).

subsystems.title: Text rendering
subsystems.notes: Twb_MemSur, Twb_PlainPic, Twb_Chinese bitmap fonts.

subsystems.title: Login, server and character selection
subsystems.notes: Server list and health checks (TServerDetect), account and password forms, character selection, deletion, notices.

subsystems.title: Character creation
subsystems.notes: TJK_RoleImage, TJK_mansel and TRE_CreateCharacter (region 173).

subsystems.title: Roles: players, NPCs, sprites
subsystems.notes: THuman, TBaseNpc, TMapNpc, TPlayers. Ported: sprite layering and colours, NPC looks and props, walking, peers, frame stepping. Not yet: emotes and poses, riding, transforms, follow NPCs, wandering NPCs, NPC turning.

subsystems.title: Ground, scene objects and map data
subsystems.notes: TGround, TGroundObj, TMap, TFSceneData. Ported: scene layers, walk grid, objects and depth order, sound zones, camera. Not yet: translucent objects, the map's other lists (sub-regions, the optional grid).

subsystems.title: Game data tables (eve, Npc.dat, scenes, skills)
subsystems.notes: TEveData, TRe_Npc, TRE_Scene, TFSkill, TFNpc and the Npc.dat lookup; read from the data/ exports.

subsystems.title: Events, NPC clicks, doors and areas
subsystems.notes: TEventManage: map NPC creation, clicks, the event interpreter (kinds 1, 5, 6), area triggers (20/8), door lights, sprite placement (FUN_002fe8e8). Not yet: event kinds 2-4 and 7+, NPC walk-in areas (20/2, 20/3), the treasure light.

subsystems.title: Movies, weather and scene effects
subsystems.notes: TMovie (.sty): actors, camera, lines, pictures, stage effects, music. Weather particles. Not yet: weather overlays 1-3 and 10 in movies, actor trails and draw modes.

subsystems.title: Talk and question windows
subsystems.notes: TSe_TalkMsgFormPlus and its variants: faces, bodies, markup, questions, the wide form. Not yet: item and trade question forms, OK-only mode, scrolling and typing, the talk cursor.

subsystems.title: Chat log and input bar
subsystems.notes: TTalkMsgForm, TSe_CharMsg. Not yet: click-through hit test, scrolling, lock, resizing, modes, emoticons, whispers.

subsystems.title: HUD: status, hot keys, buttons, team, emotes
subsystems.notes: TSe_MainStatus, TSe_HotKeyForm, the button bars, TSe_StatusInfoForm, TSe_TeamForm, TSe_EmotiomForm, skill buttons. Drawn; most actions not wired.

subsystems.title: Minimap, world map and map frame
subsystems.notes: CH_TMiniMapForm, Tse_MapFrame, TSe_SmallMap, THL_WorldMapForm, user\Map data.

subsystems.title: Cursor and mouse state
subsystems.notes: Tjo_Cursor and the cursor states; native cursors through the patched Ebitengine.

subsystems.title: Sound effects, music centre, volume
subsystems.notes: Tsound effect list, TFMark, TMusicCenter (jukebox), the volume form. Ported: effects, map music, ambience, movie music. Not yet: the jukebox, sound options and volume sliders.

subsystems.title: Items, inventory and equipment
subsystems.notes: TFItem, TSe_itemObject, TSe_ItemImage, item grids, TEquip, equip forms, crafting materials. Item data and sprite layering, native combined/status/bag forms, item icons, native item-info layout/type/rank/trade flags, capacity-limited drag quantities, use, equipment swaps and AC23 updates are ported. Remaining: full equipment bonus/socket/forge tooltip rules, repair, stat allocation/potential dialogs, pet equipment, secondary item containers and crafting.

subsystems.title: Battle
subsystems.notes: CH_TBattleGround, CH_TBattleMotion, TSkill, TAttack, TFightHum, TFightField, TFightManage. The server side is ported.

subsystems.title: Options, teams, organisations, rankings
subsystems.notes: TCY_OptionForm, TCY_SystemTeam, TLD_Top100Form, TCY_OrganManage, TCY_TeamManage.

subsystems.title: Trade, stalls and vendors
subsystems.notes: TCY_TradeMenu, vendor and stall forms, TTradeManage.

subsystems.title: Friends, mail, guilds, weddings, PK
subsystems.notes: TAC_ICQList, mail forms, TSe_ArmyForm (guilds), wedding and couple lists, block lists, PK and cooperative fights.

subsystems.title: Shops, IM mall and skill trees
subsystems.notes: THL_ShoppingForm, THL_ShoppingCarForm, TSe_SkillTreeForm.

subsystems.title: NPC services and feature forms
subsystems.notes: Careers, dungeon missions, mail boxes, notice boards, banking, express, auto-play, crafting (TRe_CompoundForm), inns, titles, lottery, exchange lock, quest views (Tjo_TaskView), effect lights. Notice board and creation are ported.

subsystems.title: Housing and furniture
subsystems.notes: TRE_FurnitureMng, TGdThing, home pillars, furniture drawing, NPC dolls.

subsystems.title: Pets and riding
subsystems.notes: CH_TRidePet, ride pet positions (Data\AdjustRidePetPos.txt), pet forms.

subsystems.title: Minigames and casino games
subsystems.notes: Sports (sheep, catch doll, boxing, Mario, memory, turn, gobang, pumpkin, dig hole, poke, catcher, lucky, conundrum, watermelon, egg, slot machines, scotd, hunter), chess, dice, lotto, the MP3 player. The sport manager, scotd (2), moles (3), hunting (4), dreams (5), lucky (13), numbered memory (15) and pumpkin (17) are playable; scotd/pumpkin native collision and animation fidelity remains partial. Egg draws (6/22) and slots (8/10/19) have native client AC71 flows; these five kinds have atomic server purchases and weighted rewards. Other paid kinds remain pending. See docs/MINIGAMES.md.

subsystems.title: GM tools
subsystems.notes: TGmManage and the GM form.
